cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.

mechanism: A corrects a neighbor's vague permission and temporal objection into a precise dated acknowledgment before paying for a boundary fence.
confusable: Securing permanent control differs from D172; A can allow later revision while documenting the present position.
comparison: A private boundary expense differs from a repeat festival committee decision.
seedUse: Keep builder payment, suppose and forever concern; remove a questionable claim about what the builder can invoice.
